status: recommendation from free local scripts; thresholds are frozen (a change needs a re-run of eval_hft.py and select_links.py); what is pushed versus pulled is the user's decision (push limits are not decided). The thresholds are PUSH LIMITS, not definitions of signal: the selection rule maximises the dev-half lower bound of lift, a precision criterion, and looser variants still carry signal (root co-occurrence PMI > 1: lift 1.28 [1.167, 1.415]; quran-slm top 5%: 1.42 [1.332, 1.514]; pointer with no card threshold: 2.27 [1.769, 2.942]). Every candidate of every type stays in the pull file; nothing is pruned (review M5).
question: does a path of this type connect a neighbour-activated dictionary branch to the word that activated it, more often than it connects the same branch to another word of the ayah (matched on frequency, and on part of speech), and more often than another branch of the same root to the same word?

evaluation_set.source: HFT surprising_valid_outliers (Sol, max effort) whose first trace step activates a non-B001 branch of a focus word and whose trace cites another root of the same ayah; named surahs excluded (K-northstar-critic/hft_na_set.py); the E3 blind surahs 19 and 88 held out (review m12)
evaluation_set.split: dev = odd surahs, test = even surahs
evaluation_set.ci: percentile bootstrap, 2,000 resamples, clustered by ayah (and by surah)

selection_rule:
(fixed in this file; volume is reported, never used to gate -- no caps):
  1. Per family, among its candidate variants, pick the one with the highest DEV-half (odd surahs) lower 95% bound
     of lift_af (frequency-matched other word of the same ayah, ayah-cluster bootstrap). A variant needs at least
     10 true paths on the dev half to be eligible (below that the bound is not estimable).
  2. The family is INCLUDED if, on the TEST half (even surahs), that variant's lift_af lower bound is > 1.
     It is marked branch-discriminating if its test-half lift_b lower bound is also > 1 (branch->root scope only).
  3. A family whose every variant has test lift_af upper bound <= 1.05 or dev lower bound < 1 is EXCLUDED as carrying
     no activation signal on this set.
label_caveats: HFT labels come from Sol readers and share their biases: they are surprise-seeking, canonical-leaning in what they accept as valid, and 13% of the target branches are collocation-bound (construction drift in the labels themselves).

The HFT readers saw each focus branch's image and definition (what_is) and the images of the neighbour roots' branches, but not the early source phrases, the dictionary neighbour relations, Qnet keywords or co-citations. Types built from the visible card text (definitional pointer, quran-slm card similarity, Qnet keywords generated from the same card prose) share the labeller's input and are likely inflated; the pointer restricted to the unseen early phrases has a lower lift (1.49, 95% CI [0.946, 2.427]) than the pointer in the seen fields (2.83).

Only within-ayah neighbour activation of non-B001 branches is tested. Cross-ayah links (window, surah, parallels such as formula echoes) and plain-sense activation are untested here; the 29:38 check is in-sample and never tuned anything.

Activators are rarer content words than the average word of an ayah (median 74 vs 177 ayat), so the unmatched base rate is biased; all decisions use the frequency-matched base, and a POS+frequency matched base gives the same conclusions.
Even the whole recommended set reaches only 38% of HFT activator pairs; most neighbour activations have no script path.

What "excluded" and "no signal" mean here: the type does not single out the cited activator among the other words of the ayah. HFT lists only the activators its readers cited, so real but uncited activators sit in the base, and a type that reaches many words scores near 1 even when it carries signal (review M6). The test is within-ayah only; an excluded type may still serve another job (cross-ayah parallels, formula echoes).
display_rules: Descriptive lines only: no score, rank, PMI value, similarity value, confidence, count used for sorting, or any verdict (present/absent, strong/weak) in anything a model reads.
Lines sit under their branch; branches in dictionary order; partner words in ayah word order; witness ayat in Quran order.
Every branch line keeps its branch_kind scope note (the construction guard applies to link lines as to branch lines).
No numeric limit on the number of lines of an included type (no caps); sizes are reported, not trimmed.
Nothing named in the North Star or the watch cases may appear in a template or an example.

rule.source: dictionary tr entry of the branch: branch_image_ar, what_is_ar, source_phrase_ar (source tags removed); what_is_not_ar is never used
rule.normalize: strip diacritics and tatweel; أإآٱ→ا, ى→ي, ة→ه, ؤ→و, ئ→ي
rule.match: whole word: a token equals a QAC lemma (article removed) or a single-root surface form; the least-stripped spelling wins (token; minus pronoun suffix ها هم هن كم نا ه ك; minus prefix وال فال بال كال لل ال و ف ب ل ك with at least 3 letters left; both)
rule.skip: function words (lib.STOP_TOK) and و/ف + function word; the branch's own root; ء ل ه
rule.threshold: the named root is named in the texts of at most 400 of the dictionary's 11,773 branches (card df over the same three fields)
rule.direction: from every branch of every root in the ayah to every other word of the ayah whose root it names (validated); to window or surah words: allowed, not validated here

why_not_pushed: It passes the signal test (branch-discriminating too), but its volume is large and unbounded: mean 67 lines and 3858 calibrated tokens per ayah, 105070 tokens at 2:282; pushing it needs a push limit, which is undecided.
It is unexplained similarity (no typed path in words); Phase 2 kept quran-slm pair lists out of the prompt.
Qnet keywords are English atoms a model produced from memory from the branch prose, not dictionary text: they may serve as an index, never as evidence or as displayed wording.
Both quran-slm and Qnet read the same card text the HFT readers saw, so their lift is the most exposed to label bias.
Correction of scope: Phase 2 found quran-slm at chance for ORDERING a word's branches; as top-1% path existence it is well above chance on the same HFT set.
